entities.name: Augusto Giomo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Augusto Giomo was an Italian basketball player. He competed at the 1960 and 1964 Olympics and finished in fourth and fifth place, respectively. His younger brother Giorgio played for Italy at the 1972 Games.
